title: Two events at the same venue and time
expected: Exclusion constraint refuses the second booking: "The venue is already booked for some of those hours"
observed: The venue is already booked for some of those hours

title: Register a donor who donated recently
expected: Trigger refuses: donor can donate again only from <date>
observed: Manish Pillai can donate again only from 18 Dec 2026

title: Register the same donor twice for one drive
expected: Refused: "This donor is already registered for this drive (registered)"
observed: This donor is already registered for this drive (registered)

title: Register for a drive that is full
expected: Trigger refuses: "The drive is full (4 donors)"
observed: The drive is full (4 donors)

title: Screening with low hemoglobin (11.8 g/dL)
expected: Outcome DEFERRED: Low hemoglobin; registration becomes DEFERRED; donor gets a return-date reminder
observed: DEFERRED: Low hemoglobin (below 12.5 g/dL) | registration=DEFERRED | reminder: Thank you for coming. You were deferred (Low hemoglobin (below 12.5 g/dL)). You can donate again from 27 Dec 2026.

title: Screening passed, then blood collected
expected: ELIGIBLE; 450 ml chosen for 72 kg; registration DONATED; thank-you reminder and activity-log row written by triggers
observed: ELIGIBLE | volume=450 ml | registration=DONATED | thank-you reminders=1 | log rows=1

title: 450 ml requested from a 52 kg donor
expected: Trigger refuses: "450 ml needs a donor above 55 kg"
observed: 450 ml needs a donor above 55 kg (this donor weighs 52.0 kg); use 350 ml

title: Collect blood before screening
expected: Trigger refuses: registration is REGISTERED (it must be SCREENED)
observed: Cannot collect blood: registration 83 is REGISTERED (it must be SCREENED)

title: Collect blood from a deferred donor
expected: Trigger refuses: registration is DEFERRED
observed: Cannot collect blood: registration 83 is DEFERRED (it must be SCREENED)

title: Volunteer tries to record a screening
expected: Refused: "Only ADMIN or COORDINATOR can do this"
observed: Only ADMIN or COORDINATOR can do this

title: Ask an A+ donor to help an O- patient
expected: Trigger refuses: "Blood group A+ cannot be given to a patient of group O-"
observed: Blood group A+ cannot be given to a patient of group O-

title: Ask a donor who donated recently to help a patient
expected: Trigger refuses: donor can donate again only from <date>
observed: Manish Pillai can donate again only from 18 Dec 2026

title: Mark a donor as donated before they accepted
expected: Trigger refuses: "A response cannot change from CONTACTED to DONATED"
observed: A response cannot change from CONTACTED to DONATED

title: One unit needed, one donor donates
expected: Trigger sets the request to FULFILLED and notifies the member who raised it
observed: request status=FULFILLED | fulfilment notifications=1

title: Raise an emergency request
expected: Trigger writes one notification for the admin and each of the 3 coordinators (4 in all)
observed: 4 notifications | CRITICAL: 2 unit(s) of B+ needed at Sunrise Multispeciality Hospital by 28 Nov

title: Insert a donor born in 2012 (under 18)
expected: CHECK constraint donor_dob_check refuses the row
observed: new row for relation "donor" violates check constraint "donor_dob_check"

title: Add a donor aged 17 through fn_add_donor
expected: Refused: "A donor must be between 18 and 65 years old"
observed: A donor must be between 18 and 65 years old

title: Cancel a drive that has registrations
expected: Trigger cancels all waiting registrations and queues a message for each donor
observed: 4 registrations cancelled | 4 drive-cancelled reminders queued

title: Close a drive while a screened donor has no bag recorded
expected: Refused: "1 donor(s) passed screening but have no donation recorded yet"
observed: 1 donor(s) passed screening but have no donation recorded yet

title: Delete a donation row
expected: Trigger refuses: rows of donation are never deleted
observed: Rows of donation are never deleted (audit rule); change their status instead

title: Web-app role inserts into a table directly
expected: Refused: permission denied for table donor
observed: permission denied for table donor

title: Web-app role reads password hashes
expected: Refused: permission denied for table member
observed: permission denied for table member

title: A volunteer blocks a member
expected: Refused: "Only ADMIN can do this"
observed: Only ADMIN can do this

title: Eligible-again reminders run twice
expected: First call adds reminders, second call adds 0 (one per donor in 30 days)
observed: first call adds 16, second call adds 0

title: Open request whose date has passed
expected: fn_expire_requests sets it to EXPIRED
observed: 2 expired | status=EXPIRED

title: Reuse a bag number
expected: Refused by UNIQUE(bag_no): "Bag number ... is already used"
observed: Bag number RS2606-001 is already used, or this registration already has a donation

title: Hand the bags of a drive to the blood bank
expected: Collected bag becomes HANDED_OVER with a timestamp
observed: 1 bag handed over | status=HANDED_OVER

title: Eligibility function on two dates
expected: Not eligible on 12 Dec 2026, eligible (NULL) on 1 Feb 2027
observed: on 12 Dec: Manish Pillai can donate again only from 18 Dec 2026 | on 1 Feb 2027: None

title: Two open requests for the same patient, hospital and group
expected: Partial unique index refuses the second: "An open request for this patient ... already exists"
observed: An open request for this patient, hospital and blood group already exists
